attack_reference: Attack 11 and 12: Stale Policy/Invariant Cache Exploitation
description: Simulates exploitation of stale policy and invariant caches in distributed verifiers. Policy updates propagate slowly through the system, creating windows where some verifiers enforce outdated policies while others have updated policies.
mitigation_target: Synchronous Policy Updates, Policy Version Enforcement, Cache TTL, State-Root Binding

execution_phases.name: baseline_consensus
execution_phases.description: All verifiers operational with consistent policy version 1.0.0

execution_phases.name: emergency_policy_update
execution_phases.description: Emergency policy update committed to block exploitation attempt

execution_phases.name: stale_cache_exploitation_window
execution_phases.description: Adversary exploits window where some verifiers still have stale policy

execution_phases.name: invariant_cache_violation
execution_phases.description: Invariant cache staleness allows violation of conservation invariant

execution_phases.name: cache_propagation_completion
execution_phases.description: All caches eventually converge to current policy and invariant state

execution_phases.name: violation_detection_and_response
execution_phases.description: System detects invariant violations from exploitation and responds

attack_vectors.name: Policy Cache Propagation Delay Exploitation
attack_vectors.description: Adversary identifies verifiers with stale policy cache and routes policy-violating transactions to them

attack_vectors.name: Invariant Cache Staleness Exploitation
attack_vectors.description: Adversary exploits stale invariant cache to execute operations that violate current invariants

attack_vectors.name: Selective Verifier Targeting
attack_vectors.description: Adversary monitors verifier cache states and dynamically routes to most favorable verifier

invariant_checks.description: All verifiers enforce consistent policy version for any given transaction
All cache entries reflect state no older than TTL threshold
Total value in system remains constant

critical: Emergency policy updates take 30+ seconds to propagate
Verifiers accept transactions under stale policy during propagation
No automatic rollback of exploited transactions
high: Cache TTL too long for emergency policy context
No state-root binding on invariant cache entries
medium: No differential cache TTL for critical vs routine policies

tests.description: Verify synchronous policy updates prevent exploitation
Verify policy version enforcement rejects stale policy transactions
Verify state-root binding invalidates stale invariant cache

success_criteria: Policy updates propagate to all verifiers within 5 seconds
No transactions accepted under stale policy after propagation completes
Invariant cache invalidates immediately on state-changing operations
